scheme.question: A trader buys 6 crates of eggs at ₦4,500 each. What is the total cost?
State two functions of blood.
accept: 1 mark each, any two: transports oxygen; fights germs/infection/disease (defence); transports nutrients/food; transports waste/carbon dioxide; clotting; distributes heat/hormones

scheme.question: State three functions of the liver.
accept: 1 mark each, any three: produces/makes bile; stores glycogen (accept stores sugar/glucose); removes toxins/detoxification; deamination/breaks down excess amino acids; produces heat; stores vitamins/iron

scheme.question: Name the process by which green plants make their food.
What is the function of the red blood cell?
accept: transports/carries oxygen (do NOT accept fighting disease: that is white blood cells)

truthText.1: Blood carries oxygen round the body and it fights germs
truthText.2: It makes bile and stores sugar
